messages:
anya: Quick follow-up: proposing per-customer budgeted precision safety-net. Each customer profile can set token_budget and degrade_mode. runtime must honor pin/override precedence and stop upgrades when budget exhausted.
sam: +1. We need atomic counters sharded by tenant. Prefer a leaky-bucket in the routing layer to avoid cross-worker sync.
lia: runtime caveat: avoid per-request RPC for budget checks. Use a cached balance with TTL and best-effort decrement.
mike: ops: every budget draw needs an audit event with reason code and request tags. Also require a global emergency kill switch for upgrades.
jordan: telemetry: emit per-tenant budget_usage and a rolling precision-FP rate (upgrades vs confirmed degradation) to tune defaults.
ops-sre: runbook bullets: - alert when burn_rate > 50% of budget in 1h - auto-disable auto-upgrades if overspend detected - manual CLI override: `rictl quant budget --tenant t123 --disable` - escalation: page SRE if audit_event_error occurs.
devops-bot: deploybot: rolling deploy started service=quant-router cfg=budgeted-safety-2026-03-23
anya: thanks. next steps: @sam design sharded counter, @lia add cached balance API and TTL, @jordan add dashboards, @ops-sre draft alerts and thresholds. 15m sync tomorrow.
sam: opening PR for counter design.
lia: will update schema: add `token_budget`, `degrade_mode`, `budget_ttl_seconds` to quant_profile spec.
mike: will stub audit event format and global kill API.
anya: closing thread. :thumbsup:
